sentences.en: I wore out two pairs of jogging shoes last year.
sentences.zh: 去年我穿坏了两双跑步鞋。

sentences.en: A good pair of glasses will help you to read.
sentences.zh: 一副好眼镜能帮助你看清楚。

sentences.en: This pair of lovers were carrying on an ardent correspondence.
sentences.zh: 这对恋人通过书信保持着热烈的交流。

senses.zh: 一副，一条，一把；一双，一对一对男女，一对夫妇雌雄成对的动物套在一起的两匹马
